description:
Make discovery's final-round configuration parse the one parse a mutation attempt performs, carrying it into `MutationBase` and template application.

## Background

- The discovery loop in `crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs` (~395-406) re-runs discovery on the round that returns the image; its configuration parse (`effective_config`, `crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs` ~591) is discarded before `MutationBase::declarations()` parses again (`commands/mod.rs` ~1048).
- Creation, field, lifecycle, batch, bulk, deletion and dependency paths therefore parse the final configuration at least twice; render, registry and preset mutations twice; template application three times (`crates/jit/src/commands/template.rs` ~383, ~466, ~480).
- Story `d675102c` sol checkpoint review, finding 2. Invoker ruling: discovery's final-round parse is the one parse; one test owns the property.
- Epic criterion: `b697a3f7` REQ-10 (each mutation attempt parses its declarations once per captured image).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A mutation attempt parses its configuration declarations once per captured image: the round that returns the image does not re-run `effective_config`, and the parse discovery made is carried into `MutationBase` and template application.
- [hard] REQ-02: One test owns "one parse per captured image", observing the assembler's parse count over a mutation and over template application; no per-command parse-count tests are added.
- [hard] REQ-03: Behaviour of every mutation is unchanged.
title: A mutation attempt parses its configuration once per captured image
